question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the given group of words.

A person who has excessive admiration of themselves
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"narcissist"** refers to a person who has an excessive admiration of themselves. (**आत्ममुग्ध व्यक्ति)**

 
 
• **Example: **He is such a** narcissist** that he spends hours looking at himself in the mirror.
 
 
 
• **"Narcissist" **means someone who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves and their physical appearance. **(आत्ममुग्ध व्यक्ति**)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **narcissistic** tendencies make it difficult for her to maintain healthy relationships.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a person who has excessive admiration of themselves is called a **'narcissist'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Egotist **(अहंवादी): A person who is excessively conceited or absorbed in themselves.

 
 
• **Example:** The ***egotist ***never considers anyone else's feelings.
 
 
 
• **Egocentric **(स्वकेन्द्रित ): Thinking only of oneself, without regard for the feelings or desires of others.
 
 
• **Example: **His ***egocentric*** attitude makes him a difficult person to work with.
 
 
 
• **Fanatic** (कट्टर): A person filled with excessive and single-minded zeal, especially for an extreme religious or political cause.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a*** fanatic*** when it comes to his political beliefs.
